mapper.sql: m.id, m.sender_id, m.receiver_id, m.role_id, m.type, m.content, m.status, m.del_flag, m.create_time, m.update_time, u1.username as sender_username, u2.username as receiver_username, u1.realname
mapper.select: SELECT FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u1 ON m.sender_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON m.receiver_id = u2.id WHERE m.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET sender_id = #{et.senderId}, receiver_id = #{et.receiverId}, role_id = #{et.roleId}, type = #{et.type}, content = #{et.content}, status = #{et.status}, del_flag = #{et.delFlag}, update_time = #{et.updateTime} WHERE id = #{et.id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (sender_id, receiver_id, role_id, type, content, status, del_flag, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{roleId}, #{type}, #{content}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, now(), now())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u1 ON m.sender_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON m.receiver_id = u2.id WHERE m.receiver_id IS NULL AND m.role_id IS NULL
SELECT FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u1 ON m.sender_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON m.receiver_id = u2.id WHERE m.role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u1 ON m.sender_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON m.receiver_id = u2.id WHERE m.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%')
SELECT m.*, u.realname FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.sender_id = u.id WHERE (m.receiver_id IS NULL AND m.role_id IS NULL) OR m.role_id = 3 OR m.sender_id = #{currentUserId}
SELECT FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u1 ON m.sender_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON m.receiver_id = u2.id WHERE m.receiver_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
